name: entra-id
description: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) directory integration via Microsoft Graph — search users and groups, inspect a user's profile, manager, and group memberships, list group and admin-role members, review sign-in logs, and list app registrations with client-secret expiry dates. All tools are read-only. Uses app-only (client-credentials) auth and requires the Directory.Read.All application permission with admin consent (plus AuditLog.Read.All and an Entra ID P1/P2 license for sign-in logs).
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Microsoft Entra ID directory (users, groups, roles, sign-ins) via Microsoft Graph (app-only)

fields.label: Directory (Tenant) ID
fields.helpText: The Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) of your organization.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.helpText: The Application (client) ID of the app registration.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A client secret for the app registration. Requires the Directory.Read.All application permission with admin consent; AuditLog.Read.All additionally for sign-in logs.

tools.name: entra.search_users
tools.description: Search directory users by display name or email. Uses Microsoft Graph $search (token match) by default, or a startswith prefix filter on displayName/mail/userPrincipalName when prefix is true. Returns id, displayName, mail, userPrincipalName, jobTitle, department, and accountEnabled. Results capped at 100.

query.description: Search term to match against display name or email address

prefix.description: If true, use a startswith prefix filter on displayName, mail, and userPrincipalName instead of $search (default false)

tools.name: entra.get_user
tools.description: Get a single user's directory profile by object id or userPrincipalName, including job title, department, account status, and their manager (id, displayName, mail).

userId.description: User object id (GUID) or userPrincipalName (e.g. alice@contoso.com)

tools.name: entra.list_user_groups
tools.description: List the groups a user is a direct member of (groups only — directory roles and administrative units are excluded server-side). Returns group id, displayName, and groupTypes. Results capped at 100 (first page only).

tools.name: entra.search_groups
tools.description: Search directory groups by display name. Uses Microsoft Graph $search (token match) by default, or a startswith(displayName, ...) prefix filter when prefix is true. Returns id, displayName, mail, groupTypes, and securityEnabled. Results capped at 100.

query.description: Search term to match against the group display name

prefix.description: If true, use a startswith(displayName, ...) prefix filter instead of $search (default false)

tools.name: entra.list_group_members
tools.description: List the direct members of a group (users, groups, devices, service principals). Follows pagination up to 5 pages and caps results at 200; the response includes a truncated flag when more members exist. Returns id, displayName, mail, userPrincipalName, and member type.

tools.name: entra.list_role_members
tools.description: List the members of an activated directory (admin) role by its display name, e.g. 'Global Administrator'. Follows pagination up to 5 pages and caps results at 200; the response includes a truncated flag when more members exist. If the role has never been assigned (not activated), returns a message plus the list of activated role names.

roleName.description: Directory role display name (e.g. 'Global Administrator', 'User Administrator'); case-insensitive

tools.name: entra.list_signin_logs
tools.description: List Entra sign-in log entries since a given time, optionally filtered by user, application, or sign-in error code. Requires AuditLog.Read.All and an Entra ID P1/P2 license. Results capped at 50 (first page only).

since.description: Only return sign-ins created at or after this time (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-07-16T00:00:00Z)

userPrincipalName.description: Filter to sign-ins by this userPrincipalName (exact match)

appDisplayName.description: Filter to sign-ins to this application display name (exact match)

errorCode.description: Filter by sign-in status error code (0 = success; e.g. 50126 = invalid credentials)

tools.name: entra.list_applications
tools.description: List app registrations in the tenant with their client-secret expiry dates (passwordCredentials endDateTime only), useful for flagging expiring secrets. Results capped at 100 (first page only).
